articles.title: Barratt Redrow (LSE:BTRW) Stock Gets Fair Value Trim As Analysts Cut Growth Views
articles.summary: For Barratt Redrow, the latest analyst work trims fair value from £3.44 to about £3.32 per share, a reduction of roughly 3.7%, and sits alongside individual price targets that now cluster around this level or below. Some analysts still highlight upside potential with targets such as 348 GBp or 350 GBp, while others have moved down to 260 GBp and shifted to more neutral ratings, which underlines how divided views have become.
